_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The souls of the righteous are in the hand of God.
No torment will ever touch them.
Lift up your heads, O gates;
the King of glory comes in.
See, the home of God is among mortals.
Death will be no more, and every tear wiped away.
Come, let us worship with all the saints.
We come, and they come with us. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: At the tomb of his friend Jesus wept, and then he called with a loud voice: Lazarus, come out! Unbind him, and let him go.
God will wipe away every tear.
For the souls of the faithful are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them; they are at peace.
God will wipe away every tear.
See, God is making all things new — a new heaven, a new earth, and death itself undone.
God will wipe away every tear.
So lift up your heads, you gates; the King of glory is coming, and a great cloud of witnesses comes with him. Come, let us worship.
God will wipe away every tear. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The souls of the righteous rest in God's hand.
Death shall be no more.
Jesus stood at the grave and called Lazarus out.
Death shall be no more.
God makes all things new and wipes every tear.
Death shall be no more.
Come, let us worship with all the saints.
God will wipe away every tear. Amen.
